The '''''Sarapin Wanderer''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in the service of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The ''Sarapin Wanderer'' was traveling with several other Republic vessels when it was [[Unidentified space battle (Oteg)|attacked]] by the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]], and the vessel's [[Unidentified captain (Sarapin Wanderer)|captain]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]]. However, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Oteg]] was aboard the ''Wanderer'', and [[Gender/Legends|he]] took command of the vessel, organizing a counterattack that drove the Imperial attackers into a [[Unidentified nebula|nearby nebula]]. The Imperials attempted to return fire, but they were destroyed when their own weapons detonated the gases of the nebula.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Sarapin Wanderer'' was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', published by [[Dorling Kindersley]] as a tie-in to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
